root.command:
IF OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.SaPostalCodeTbl', N'U') IS NULL
BEGIN
CREATE TABLE dbo.SaPostalCodeTbl
(
PostalCodeID INT IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL CONSTRAINT PK_SaPostalCodeTbl PRIMARY KEY,
PostalCode INT NOT NULL,
PlaceName NVARCHAR(120) NOT NULL,
Province NVARCHAR(80) NULL,
Municipality NVARCHAR(120) NULL,
Latitude DECIMAL(9,6) NULL,
Longitude DECIMAL(9,6) NULL
);
CREATE INDEX IX_SaPostalCode_Code ON dbo.SaPostalCodeTbl (PostalCode);
CREATE INDEX IX_SaPostalCode_Place ON dbo.SaPostalCodeTbl (PlaceName);
END
